today.source: Harvard Business Review — How to Give Feedback People Can Actually Use
today.listen_task: First pass: notice the difference between judging a person and describing an observable impact. On the second listen, identify the one question that would help the other person respond.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, give a colleague useful feedback on a delayed handover: name the specific effect, ask what got in the way, and agree on one change for next time.

phrases.note: Start with a specific observation instead of a judgement.
Explain why the issue mattered to the team or customer.

phrases.phrase: What would make this easier next time?

history.theme: Disagree constructively and move the conversation forward
